headline: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan meets Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on the margins of COP31:
content:
- Efforts would continue to deepen cooperation, particularly in transport and defence industries

- Both countries would work together to help end conflict in Iran and support peaceful solutions to Pakistan’s regional challenges

- Erdogan expressed condolences over those killed in an attack on police convoy in Pakistan
